![Shaarli logo](doc/md/images/doc-logo.png)

The personal, minimalist, super fast, database-free, bookmarking service.

_Do you want to share the links you discover?_ _Shaarli is a minimalist link sharing service that you can install on your own server._ _It is designed to be personal (single-user), fast and handy._
